Hi Daniel,
Thanks for the update. Could you please let us know if you remember which EV manufacturer and model was being charged on that day? I can see in the charger logs that it doesn’t proceed past Authentication in all the charging sessions that occurred on January 17th. We’ve observed multiple instances in the logs where the PLC link was not established with the EV.
In the meantime, we are analyzing the logs and will update you on the status of troubleshooting shortly
Thank you.
